turns.text: Hello, my print still hasn't arrived and I need help with the delivery.

Hello, I am sorry your print has not arrived yet. I can help you check it. Please send me your order number (it starts with SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
I'm filing a complaint with the consumer authority ANPC today. I'll also contact my bank for a chargeback and leave a public review.

I understand your frustration, and I am sorry your print has not arrived. I have passed your message to a colleague, who will take over the conversation and help you with the delivery. You are welcome to keep your order number and email ready for them.

input.summary: Customer says their print has not arrived and wants help with the delivery. They have not yet given an order number or email, so they are not verified and no order was looked up. They said they will file a complaint with the consumer authority (ANPC) today, start a chargeback with their bank, and leave a public review. Please contact them to take the delivery issue forward.
